summary: PHASE 1 backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass covering opponents/search (ALL athletes for ANY sport with plays_sport flag), /matches/preview + /matches/submit auto-add player_sport for a brand-new sport, verified-vs-seed auto-creates match_result feed post, /social/feed enrichment, /feed/{id}/react add/switch/toggle-off and unknown-type 400, /feed/{id}/comment + /feed/{id} detail with ordered comments and empty-text 400, /matches/detail/{id} shape with category=oneoff, /feed/share-match creates shared_match feed post visible in /social/feed and returns 403 for non-participants. Frontend: splash '/' auto-advances to /auth within ~2.6s for unauthenticated users as specified; /(tabs)/score screen renders the Phase 1 fast flow (header 'SCORE MATCH', subtitle 'Pick a sport, an opponent, then go live or enter a final score', stepper 1-2-3, 'All ATHLERA sports are available. New sports start at a provisional rating.') with the raised center SCORE tab visible. Full authenticated in-app clickthrough (pick-sport → opponent → match-type → method → confirm-submit) was NOT completed by this test agent because the auth-context does not persist a token via localStorage, so I could not shortcut sign-in; the UI sign-in submit needs to be exercised by main agent to fully validate pick-sport-<id>/opponent-search/etc. testIDs. Deprecated RN style-prop warnings observed (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents) — non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: When /(tabs)/social is opened without a valid bearer token (e.g. direct deep-link or expired session) the API 401 propagates as a raw red-screen 'Missing bearer token' overlay instead of gracefully redirecting to /auth or rendering an empty state. Reference: /app/frontend/src/api.ts:38 and app/(tabs)/social.tsx:28

action_items: Optional: add a lightweight auth guard in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx that redirects to /auth when the auth-context has no user, so 401s from deep-links don't surface as a red-screen overlay.
Optional cleanup: replace deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents style props with the modern boxShadow/textShadow and style.pointerEvents variants to silence RN Web warnings.

Main agent to self-verify the full Score-Match UI flow (pick-sport-<id> → opponent-search → pick-opponent-<uid> → match-type-oneoff/competition → method-live/final → game-a-0/game-b-0 → preview-rating-btn → confirm-submit-btn → match-submitted → view-match-btn/share-feed-btn) end-to-end after a successful UI sign-in; the backend contract underneath is fully green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 2242-line module — future maintainability would benefit from splitting into routers (auth, opponents, matches, social/feed, live, competitions, events, ltp) but this is out of Phase 1 scope.

opponents/search caps at 60 results after merging rated + unrated (server.py:794); with a growing user base the 'unrated' section may hide relevant seed opponents further down the list. Consider paginating or scoring by proximity/city.
feed_react toggling behaviour is correct (same reaction clears, new reaction replaces) — matches Phase 1 spec.
matches/preview and matches/submit correctly call ensure_player_sport for BOTH the caller and opponent (server.py:806-811), satisfying the auto-add requirement for ANY sport.

success_rate.frontend: partial (splash auto-advance + score screen shell verified; interactive fast-flow not exercised due to sign-in bootstrap not persisting on web without going through UI submit)

seed_data_creation: Two throwaway pytest users per run (QA P1 A/B) with random emails; one verified match against a seed opponent (auto-verified) which auto-creates a match_result feed post. All prefixed for identification; no seeded/production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Phase 1 is 100% green. For frontend UI, /score renders the fast-flow shell but the sport chips (pick-sport-<id>) are behind an authenticated fetch; you must first submit the SIGN IN form with the QA credentials (qa.phase1@athlera.dev / Test1234!) via the auth screen, wait for navigation into /(tabs), and only then exercise the SCORE tab. Do not try to inject a token via localStorage — auth-context persists elsewhere.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no bugs blocking Phase 1 acceptance were found.
